items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had a practice of discouraging young guys who wanted to come up and play with us. Anybody wanted to play, you know. A guy would say, “Oh, can I sit in with the band, Max?”

ctx.x: But do you recall the experience, when you were younger, of playing these very fast things?
Well, I used to work with Max Roach, see.
